metrics.name: auth_completions
metrics.pm_question: How many authentications are completed, and how does that trend over time / by auth method?

metrics.name: new_user_completion_share
metrics.pm_question: What share of completed auths are new users (signups) vs returning?

metrics.name: completions_by_acquisition_channel
metrics.pm_question: How do completed auths break down by acquisition channel?
metrics.formula: count of completions grouped by derived acquisition_channel

derived_dimension.name: acquisition_channel
derived_dimension.logic: gclid != '' -> paid_google; else fbclid != '' -> paid_meta; else organic

metrics.name: auth_completion_rate
metrics.pm_question: What is the auth completion rate (completed vs started)?
metrics.formula: count(auth_completed) / count(auth_started)  [cross-event, denominator lives in a different spec/event]
metrics.denominator: count of auth_started (not in this spec)
metrics.notes: Cross-event metric: requires auth_started events which are not part of this spec's NDJSON. Not served by an MV here; compute at query time by joining against the auth_started source once onboarded.

metrics.name: avg_attempts_per_completion
metrics.pm_question: How many attempts does it take on average to complete auth, and what fraction required a retry?
metrics.formula: sum(total_attempts) / count(completions); retry share = sum(retried_completions) / count(completions)
